subject: 1897 Palacio Legislativo competition: contradictory prize terminology and possible retrospective dating errors

records.title: Ana Fernanda Canales González, La modernidad arquitectónica en México; una mirada a través del arte y los medios impresos
records.scope: Doctoral thesis (UPM 2013), extracted PDF around lines 3257–3273 and bibliography lines 8109–8124; full relevant plan image not inspected
records.observation: Thesis distinguishes contest jury's empty first prize, Boari second, Quaglia commission, eventual Bénard appointment. Captions on architectural plates identify a Bénard Pantheon project and family archive.
quality_flags: Parsed excerpt contains obvious dating inconsistencies ('1987' for late-nineteenth century contest, '1998' for Quaglia death); verify in actual page image before using as literal dates.
Caption labels Bénard competition winner while analysis describes complex post-contest selection; 'winner' not a simple factual resolution.
Family Bénard archive attribution for 1926 pantheon drawing is a concrete next primary-source lead.
